prompts.prompt: Create a premium landscape 16:9 game art production reference sheet for the original fantasy game ARCANA GUARDIANS. Art direction: readable stylized 3D sculpted forms, broad clean bevels, substantial believable weight, charming but battle-capable, crafted materials, ivory sandstone, dark warm oak, muted teal cloth, restrained aged brass, tiny amber magic accents. Strong silhouette readable on a phone, deliberate large shapes, restrained surface detail rather than visual noise. Original woodland frontier fantasy; no borrowed franchise characters, no logos or game HUD. These are concept illustrations intended as future Blender modeling references, not screenshots, not an actual mesh export. Neutral warm light gray studio background with faint baseline, soft contact shadows, consistent lighting, sharp full objects with generous margins. Clean professionally arranged reference board. No environment scene, no border decorations, no dense text, only minimal short English panel captions where helpful. Anatomically and mechanically consistent between views. SUBJECT: one new guardian, a stout anthropomorphic river otter engineer. Entirely animal otter head, rounded muzzle, small ears, broad flat nose, warm brown fur and cream throat, dexterous paws, powerful short legs, broad hind paws, thick tapered otter tail. NOT a human with ears. A teal short sleeveless work-coat over tan padded tunic, simple dark leather belt and large bronze buckle, sturdy open-finger leather gloves, broad boots adapted to otter feet. Original off-center amber lantern strapped high to the left shoulder, tools held in a right hip holster; compact back-mounted wooden repair kit, three large tools maximum. Signature weapon is a short, chunky oak-and-brass ratchet mallet, cylindrical head with one flat striking face and one broad hook, visually distinct from a dwarf warhammer. Friendly focused expression, low stable weight, no giant head obscuring torso. LAYOUT: upper two-thirds shows precisely 4 evenly spaced full-body views of the SAME character at SAME scale: FRONT neutral A-pose empty hands with weapon holstered, LEFT SIDE neutral, BACK neutral (tail and kit fully visible), and a larger polished 3/4 READY pose holding the mallet with both hands. Align all feet on same baseline and keep head size/costume/lantern/weapon consistent. Bottom third: 3 clear small full-body keyposes LEFT FOOT CONTACT walking, LOW WIND-UP grounded mallet preparation, FOLLOW-THROUGH repair strike with planted feet and visible center of mass, plus one isolated mallet/lantern prop pair and a 5-color material strip. Show distinct paws, elbow joints, coat edge and tail root for future rigging. Do not claim any game stats or animations are implemented. Title only 'LANTERN OTTER — GUARDIAN STUDY'.

SUBJECT: a new woodland enemy, ROOTBACK BOAR. A genuinely quadrupedal heavily built forest boar with massive forward shoulders, small hard hindquarters, a low long snout, two broad ivory tusks, four separate sturdy cloven-hoofed legs, small orange-brown alert eyes and a short bristly tail. Body fur desaturated umber. An asymmetrical armor plate made from living oak roots grows across the shoulder blades, a large mossy green mass with THREE clear thick root plates, not dozens of twigs. Tiny thin arrows indicate movement direction and weight shift, not a huge cinematic VFX cloud. Each pose shows hoof contact clearly and fully within frame. Beside them a very small side cutaway visual of shoulder/root plate separable meshes, and material swatches oak, moss, fur, ivory. No damage numbers or UI. Title only 'ROOTBACK BOAR — CHARGE STUDY'.

SUBJECT: a coherent family of THREE original defensive towers, each complete and mechanically understandable, intended for one village game with no intermingled science-fiction. Arrange THREE distinct vertical columns with generous spacing. Column1 VINE BALLISTA: long horizontally spread curved oak bow limbs bound with aged brass, taut visible bowstring, ONE bolt seated on a straight rail, a central rotary bearing above four stout teal-trimmed timber legs seated on a squat sandstone base. Horizontal silhouette, not a barrel cannon. Column2 ACORN MORTAR: very low broad sandstone octagonal base, single short wide bronze mortar barrel inside a hinged oak yoke, two solid visible side trunnions and compact rear spring/slide recoil assembly. One large spherical oak-shelled brass-capped acorn bomb nearby makes the arcing ammunition obvious; keep bore clear and barrel attached to trunnions, no unexplained floating components. Low heavy silhouette. Column3 FROST RESONATOR: a narrow tall tapered ivory stone plinth, three sturdy bronze arms supporting one faceted icy blue crystal held INSIDE a collar, small teal cloth panels; clean vertical silhouette with a controlled pale blue inner glow, no particle storm. All three bases have the same world diameter, so heights and widths are comparable, shared subtle double-leaf brass emblem, coherent materials. LAYOUT: top 60% each column has one large high quality 3/4 full model illustration with unobstructed ground contact, below it small true SIDE and BACK orthographic views of exactly the same construction with constant dimensions within that column. Bottom 20% each column has a miniature TWO-STATE mechanical strip: ballista READY versus RELEASE with string forward and bolt departing; mortar LOADED versus RECOIL with barrel pushed backward along its own axis, base planted and lob trajectory arrow; resonator CHARGE versus RELEASE with crystal brightening in the fixed collar and one thin concentric ground wave. A small pivot dot on each mechanism, minimal arrows. No upgrade numbers, stats, icons, UI, pseudo blueprints or excessive words. Title 'WOODLAND DEFENSE — TURRET FAMILY'. Capture clear material separation, practical construction and stable center of mass.
